items.title: Consecutive message bubble spacing
items.precondition: Local app is running and a conversation contains consecutive messages from the same sender.
steps: Open a message thread in the local app.
Inspect consecutive grouped and ungrouped bubbles.
Compare their vertical spacing with the approved reference.
items.expected: Grouped and ungrouped consecutive message rows use a consistent 3px gap; reaction-row spacing is unchanged.
items.evidence: User completed local visual acceptance on 2026-08-07 after selecting the final 3px value.
items.notes: Vite hot reload applied the CSS while the local app was running.

items.title: Type-check and lint
items.precondition: Final CSS and plan changes are present.
items.expected: Type-check exits 0 and lint introduces no new warnings or errors.
items.evidence: Both commands exited 0 on 2026-08-07. Lint reported six pre-existing warnings in MessageQuoteStrip, PostDetailPage, PostPhotoCommentsPage, AuthContext, and ThemeContext.
items.notes: No automated CSS-specific test exists; visual acceptance is covered above.
